summary_1line: Ravana enters battle, defeats many monkeys and wounds Lakshmana, but Rama finally overpowers him and mercifully lets the exhausted king return to Lanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman carries Rama on his shoulders into battle while arrows fly as Rama confronts Ravana in his blazing chariot.
Rama fires a crescent-shaped arrow that shatters Ravana’s radiant crown, leaving the titan king stunned on the battlefield.
Hanuman leaps forward and strikes Ravana in the chest with a thunderous fist, making the ten-headed king stagger and bleed.
